notes.content:

notes.title: New Demo launches June 13th - Sign up to continue playing after Next Fest
notes.content:
Hey there Survivors! Are you ready to go on an adventure?

We are launching our brand new demo for Steam Next Fest on June 13th. It's going to include a brand new area to explore that's a total of 16 sq km with several new biomes. 

Over 25 new features added to the game plus bugfixes and more.

See all the changes on our post here: https://socksandgoats.com/blog/next-fest-update

More announcements to be announced on livestreams with Q&A with the dev.

See you there!

Want to keep playing or playtest after Next Fest, get updates and see our Roadmap?
Sign up here: [url=https://socksandgoats.com/project-canopy]Join the Project Canopy Community[/url]

notes.title: Help! I'm Stuck! How to Fix...
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

First off, thank you for leaving so much feedback! It's invaluable to us and I'm glad so many of you are enjoying the game already in these early stages. If you are getting stuck in the new build, it is highly likely that your character just ran out of oxygen. Unfortunately, in that build, we didn't have time to add the death screen, so when you run out of oxygen and the player dies, it simply freezes you in place. I know this is very confusing to people and I've already built a death screen in a new update.  

I've actually been trying to create a new build to fix just that, but I'm running into problems with the Windows version. I will patch it as soon as I can though, but I wanted to send an announcement out to everyone Playtesting just so you know what's going on. 

How do you prevent the player from running out of oxygen? You can use the oxygen filters that I added to the inventory to keep you going for a while. Each one will fill your oxygen meter up to 100%, so you can go for a while. Also, the HoverBike and starter pod both refill your oxygen when you are in them. I hope this helps in the meantime until I can get another patch out.

Thanks again!

If you want to see all the feedback we've collected so far, you can find our Feedback board here:
https://socksandgoats.com/feedback
